topic: Customizing parenting through the four pillars of Chinese astrology: two boys, two approaches, one principle -- look closer and respond to the individual child in front of you.
phrases: You don't parent a firehorse. You parent your child.
Great parenting works like great coaching.
The year gives you the weather. The full chart tells you who you are raising.
One size has never fit every child.

images.concept: A woman from behind, kneeling on the floor of a softly lit room, with a small child in front of her also facing away, both looking toward a window. The woman's posture is relaxed but attentive -- present, not hovering. Warm morning light comes through the window. On the floor beside them, two objects slightly apart from each other: a smooth river stone and a small dried flower. The two objects are different, like the two boys in the story, but both are beautiful.
images.prompt: A woman from behind, kneeling on polished dark wood floor in warm natural light. A small child sits in front of her, also facing away, both looking toward a large window with soft morning light streaming through. The woman's posture is attentive and gentle -- present without hovering. Beside them on the floor, slightly apart: a smooth grey river stone and a small dried plum blossom. The room is simple, warm ivory walls, a shaft of gold light from the upper left. Cinematic film-photography aesthetic, slightly warm tones. The feeling is quiet focus, a grown person really paying attention to a small person. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: The practice of studying the individual child. An open notebook and a brush pen on aged silk in warm light, suggesting the parent learning to read who is actually in front of them.
images.prompt: Close-up of an open notebook with a soft cream page resting on deep midnight jade silk, a dark ink brush pen lying diagonally across the lower corner. A few faint, illegible handwritten notes are visible on the page. A single shaft of warm antique gold light falls from the upper left, catching the texture of the paper and silk. The composition suggests study, attention, the practice of learning to read each child on their own terms. No text legible in the image. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: Two small cups of tea side by side on an old wooden surface. Both cups are the same shape, same ceramic, but one holds darker tea and the other is pale gold. They are the same vessel, different contents. A visual metaphor for two children in the same house, raised the same way -- but actually different inside.
images.prompt: Overhead close-up of two identical small ceramic teacups on a worn wooden surface, shot from directly above. Both cups are warm ivory with a subtle aged crackle glaze. One cup holds deep amber tea, nearly opaque. The other holds pale gold tea, almost translucent. A small sprig of dried chrysanthemum lies between them. Natural morning light from the upper left. Palette: warm ivory, deep amber, pale gold, dark wood. The image is square, centered, intimate -- the quiet difference between two things that look the same from the outside. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: A room corner at dusk, designed as a small sanctuary. A soft blanket folded over a low cushion, a candle in a glass lantern casting warm light, a window showing deep blue-green sky. The space is intentionally calm, deliberately constructed -- a pocket of peace in a high-energy world. This is the feng shui corner of the firehorse baby's room.
images.prompt: A quiet corner of a room at dusk, photographed at floor level. A small low cushion covered in soft sage green fabric, a folded warm ivory blanket, and a glass lantern with a single candle flame glowing amber in the low light. The window behind shows deep midnight jade sky fading into blue. The overall feeling is intentional calm -- a space that has been prepared, not stumbled into. Cinematic depth of field, warm candlelight from the center of the frame. Palette: sage green, warm ivory, midnight jade, antique gold light. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: A single hand -- a woman's, warm skin tones, relaxed fingers -- holding a tiny smooth river stone. The stone is perfectly round and fits in the palm. The background is blurred deep midnight jade. The image is about holding something small with complete, unhurried attention.
images.prompt: Square close-up of a woman's hand, palm open and relaxed, holding a single perfectly smooth grey river stone. The skin is warm, the fingers are unclenched and gentle. The background is blurred deep midnight jade. Overhead natural light from the upper left. The stone sits in the exact center of the palm. The image is about the act of holding something small with complete, unhurried attention -- not gripping, just present. Cinematic depth of field, warm skin tones against cool dark background. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.
